description: MOObject defines the multiOmicDataSet object class which is used in MOSuite for differential RNA-seq and multi-omics analyses. Separating the MOObject class definition from MOSuite allows for lightweight installations in downstream workflows. See the website for more information, documentation, and examples at <https://ccbr.github.io/MOObject/>.
name: MOObject: multiOmicDataSet object class for MOSuite
